qa.a: I suppose it depends on what kind actually. If it's a positive change, like, uh, if your workout at the gym is working well, then it's great. qa.q: What would you not like to change?
qa.a: Um, I don't like last-minute changes. Um, I suppose that's because I have a fixed idea of how things should be and then my expectations are set. qa.q: Have you changed a lot since your childhood?
qa.a: Oh, definitely. I used to be fat and eat junk food and I didn't study properly at all. So, all of those things have changed for the better now, I think.

qa.q: What was the last change you made?
qa.a: Well, I say I changed it, but really my personal trainer changed it. I changed my routine at the gym. Um, and by that I mean, I hired a personal trainer to help make it more effective. qa.q: What has been the greatest change in your life so far?
qa.a: Uh, probably moving to Russia, to be honest with you. I think it changed everything. Um, I gained access to more opportunities for professional development and I gained new clients and I got to do a variety of jobs which expanded my competency. So, that's been great. qa.q: Have there been any changes in your hometown recently?
qa.a: Um, I suppose it depends on how you define recently. I think there are a lot of ongoing changes down at the waterfront area. qa.q: What do you plan to change next year?

Um, and I'm planning to go all in on this podcast so we can open up a range of services online, amongst other things as well. And I'll move back home.
